issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Shariff - Preliminary Order of Forfeiture, ECF 709
supports: A money judgment forfeiture of $2,595,301.54 is entered against Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff, with credit for the net forfeited value of each asset forfeited from him.
The order becomes final as to the defendant at sentencing (Fed. R. Crim. P. 32.2(b)(4)).
does_not_support: It does not show that any dollar of the money judgment has been collected or any asset realized.
A money judgment forfeiture is not seized or recovered cash.
